name: flood
title: Riverbend Flood
synopsis: River stage rising. Road washouts. Levee integrity disputed. Hospital access at risk.

reports.text: Riverbend gauge +2.1m in 3 hours. Farm Road 12 partially washed out.
Levee patrol reports seepage but structure holding. No breach.
Water over the levee near mile marker 4. People trapped on porches.
